description: BETWEEN over a nullable column is nullable -- NULL BETWEEN 1 AND 10 is NULL, not false

columns.name: in_range
columns.note: score is nullable, so score BETWEEN 1 AND 10 is NULL when score IS NULL

name: between_nullable_operand
query_sql:
-- @name GetScoreRange
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, score BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AS in_range FROM entries
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE entries (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, score INTEGER)
